description: Hand in a student-annotation assignment (where you mark up a document inside Canvas). Do the annotating in Canvas first; this submits what is there. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: call it once for a preview and a confirm_token, show the preview to the user, and only if they say yes call it again with the same arguments, confirm=true and that confirm_token. Apps that can ask the user directly show a confirmation instead.]

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

comment.description: Comment text, visible to your instructor.

confirm.description: Set to true together with confirm_token to carry out a request you already previewed.

confirm_token.description: The one-time token from the preview. Only use it after the user has said yes.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

name: submit_annotation_assignment
title: Submit Annotation Assignment
